authority: Chapter 3 plus prediction-blind Configuration Gold boundary audit

Configuration.name: Minimum Canonical Product Unit (MCPU)
Configuration.surface: shortest continuous source span that preserves the canonical affected product or component identity

vendor.retain: an explicitly adjacent vendor in the same continuous product noun phrase

Configuration.product_designators: retain only when part of the official product or directly affected component identity
exceptions: lexicalized generation token required for product identity
device model token required for product identity
Configuration.normalization: ordinary prose mentions use a family-level CPE with wildcard version; non-wildcard versions require a literal CPE or an approved lexicalized generation identity

Weakness.formal_surface: explicit CWE mention or a descriptive flaw phrase uniquely tied to an explicit CWE in the same fact block
Weakness.candidate_only: description-only phrase without a locally explicit CWE

exploited_by.required: the AttackTechnique directly performs the specified CVE exploitation or entry behavior
exploited_by.excluded: activity that occurs before or after exploitation without a direct exploitation role
exploited_by.adjudication: semantic source-text review; no fixed ATT&CK ID blacklist

apo.test_policy: all previous Configuration prompt results are historical after the v2 boundary migration; freeze a fresh prompt before evaluating a newly reserved final test
